title: Evangelize

inlines.v: EVAN'GELIZE, verb transitive [Low Latin evangelizo.] To instruct in the gospel; to preach the gospel to, and convert to a belief of the gospel; as, to evangelize heathen nations; to evangelize the world. EVAN'GELIZE, verb intransitive To preach the gospel.
